name: @tpmjs/tools-railway
description: Railway API tools for AI agents. Manage projects, services, deployments, variables, and logs via Railway's GraphQL API.

tools.name: listProjects
tools.description: List all projects in your Railway account or workspace.

tools.name: getProject
tools.description: Get details of a specific Railway project by ID.

tools.name: getService
tools.description: Get details of a specific Railway service by ID.

tools.name: getServiceInstance
tools.description: Get configuration and deployment info for a service in a specific environment.

tools.name: listDeployments
tools.description: List deployments for a Railway service in a specific environment.

tools.name: getDeployment
tools.description: Get details of a specific Railway deployment by ID.

tools.name: getBuildLogs
tools.description: Get build logs for a Railway deployment.

tools.name: getDeploymentLogs
tools.description: Get runtime logs for a Railway deployment.

tools.name: redeployService
tools.description: Trigger a redeploy of a Railway service in an environment.

tools.name: getVariables
tools.description: Get environment variables for a Railway service in an environment.

tools.name: upsertVariable
tools.description: Create or update an environment variable on a Railway service.

tools.name: deleteVariable
tools.description: Delete an environment variable from a Railway service.
